info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Management Retrieval API provides access to customer data based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding sales product agreements associated with a given customer. Typical consumers include customer service representatives, sales teams, and business analysts who need to access customer agreements quickly for support or analysis purposes. The API enhances operational efficiency by streamlining the process of obtaining customer-related data.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific sales product agreement.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific sales product agreement identified by its unique ID. It provides all relevant data associated with the agreement, helping users to understand the terms and provisions of the sale.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the Sales Product Agreement with identifier PROD-700045. This request should include the necessary parameters to identify the specific sales product agreement being queried.

200.description: Successfully retrieved sales product agreement details.
